references.title: On P Versus NP
references.note: Current claimed P!=NP proof. C029 gives an explicit counterexample schema to Lemma 18 by adding a support of size binom(k,2)+1 that is invisible on VA_0 but accepted by the paper's positive-support AC^n relation.

references.title: On Lev Gordeev's On P Versus NP
references.note: Primary critique of an earlier version, identifying the danger of positive-only approximation. C029 independently targets the revised v10 Lemma 18 and does not merely reuse the old counterexample.
